title: Dictation — Build Order
rule: Hold a key, speak, and the right text lands where you are typing — on the Mac, with no network, and never a word you did not say except the ones you marked as a correction.

stages.name: Foundation and dictation core
stages.does: A signed menu-bar app with a stable identity, hotkeys, continuous microphone, Apple's on-device recognizer, insertion at the cursor, the floating pill and sounds.
stages.see: Hold Right Option (now Fn), speak, release: the text appears where you are typing.
stages.proof: Commits 0a28474…32bd321 (16 Aug). The on-device model was rejected for light-touch cleanup: 7.2 s median and dropped words on 2 of 10 (decision 01).

stages.name: Settings, hardening, languages
stages.does: Settings and vocabulary, launch at login, a regression corpus, fixes from daily use, transcript history, 54 languages with Arabic cleanup.
stages.see: Settings window with hotkeys, vocabulary, learned corrections and history.

stages.name: Spoken formatting and learning
stages.does: Numbers as digits, spoken punctuation, lists, brackets, the comma policy; learning from corrections and from edits you make in the app.
stages.see: "three comma four" types 3, 4; fixing a word once teaches it.
stages.proof: Commits 29fd956…9b12f80 (17–22 Aug); unit tests plus live use.

stages.name: Wispr Flow parity, first pass
stages.does: Stops pasting your old clipboard (restores it only once the paste was read), never types into a password prompt, resolves spoken corrections ("2, actually 3", "scratch that", comma-wrapped "like"), drops the full stop in chat apps, pads short dictations with silence and keeps recording 150 ms past release.
stages.see: Short messages come through; "at 2, actually 3" types "at 3"; your clipboard is never pasted instead of what you said; menu items Paste last transcript and Restore previous clipboard.
stages.proof: docs/verification.md clipboard check: 100 dictations into Claude, ChatGPT, Arc, Chrome and Terminal with SENTINEL-42 on the clipboard, pasted 0 times. **Not yet run live.** 435 unit tests pass; the lazy clipboard served another process and logged its read at +369 ms.

items.d: 1–4 s dictations were empty 7–10% of the time

stages.declaration: Declared 27 Sep before code (docs/research/2026-09-27-insertion-bugs.md, decision 11). Predictions: the sentinel is never pasted; short 1–4 s dictations stop coming back empty. Reject conditions: the sentinel is pasted even once after a PASTE restore; any ordinary sentence loses a word to the correction rules.

stages.name: Transcribe while you talk
stages.does: Feeds the recognizer while the key is held, so releasing only finalises instead of transcribing the whole clip.
stages.see: Long dictations appear as fast as short ones.
stages.proof: Release-to-text p95 at or under 700 ms for dictations under 30 s, from STREAM final lines in doctor.log. Probe (no mic): 37–54 ms for short phrases, 150–600 ms for 23–46 s clips under load. **Not yet measured live.** Before: median 2.7 s past 60 s.

stages.name: See the text box in Claude desktop
stages.does: Asks Electron apps to publish their text field at the key press, so learning from edits and paste confirmation work in Claude desktop.
stages.see: Fixing a word in Claude desktop teaches it; the clipboard comes back sooner there.
stages.proof: Probe: Claude went from 9 accessibility nodes and no focus to 713 nodes with a readable text area; no measurable CPU rise. Live: LEARN lines appear after an edit in Claude — **not yet seen.**

needs.label: Omar dictates on the new build

items.t: Arc and Chrome expose nothing to the probe

stages.name: No clipped first word
stages.does: Measures whether starting exactly at the key press clips the first syllable, and adds a small measured rewind if it does.
stages.see: The first word is always there.
stages.proof: 20 dictations starting on a hard consonant; count first-word losses (decision 09).

stages.name: Starts at login after a rebuild
stages.does: Checks that launch at login survives make all.
stages.see: After a reboot the app is running.
